fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.
validation.passwordRequired: Enter your password to sign in.
validation.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol. Avoid passwords that have appeared in a data leak.
validation.consentRequired: Tick the box to continue. Nappa needs your OK to store this information.

signIn.title: Sign in to Nappa
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Your little one’s day is waiting.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome back, {{name}}
welcomeBack.forgetDetail: Nappa will forget {{email}} on this phone. You can sign back in any time.

invalidCredentials.title: Email or password is incorrect
invalidCredentials.detail: Check both and try again, or reset your password.

wrongPassword.title: That password didn’t work
wrongPassword.detail: Check it and try again. Too many tries will pause sign-in for a minute.

locked.title: Too many tries
locked.detail: For your security, sign-in is paused for a little while.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.detail: Connect to Wi‑Fi or mobile data, then try again.

expired.title: You’ve been signed out
expired.detail: For your security, please sign in again to keep logging.

deviceForgotten.title: Sign in with your email
deviceForgotten.detail: This phone was signed out of your account. Sign in again with your email and password.

tooManyRequests.title: Too many requests
tooManyRequests.detail: Wait a minute, then try again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.detail: Please try again in a moment.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you use for Nappa. We’ll send you a link to set a new password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {{email}} has a Nappa account, we’ve sent it a link to set a new password. The link works for 60 minutes.

resent.title: Sent again
resent.detail: Check your inbox and spam folder.

createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.subtitle: Keep your baby’s day safe and see it on every phone.
createAccount.consent: I agree that Nappa can store my baby’s sleep, feeds and growth to make predictions. Only people I share with can see it.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.

resent.title: New code sent
resent.detail: It replaces the old one and works for 15 minutes.

invalid.title: That code didn’t work
invalid.detail: Check it and try again, or send a new code. Codes work for 15 minutes.

welcomeV2.title: Know the next nap before it starts
welcomeV2.body: Log feeds, naps and nappies in one tap. Nappa learns your baby’s rhythm and shares it with everyone who helps.
